scope: R1 action-only-on-frozen-features; source-code audit only; no training launch
hypothesis: R1 already matches the StarWAM/DreamWAM action-flow training contract; the first unresolved questions are whether ActionDiT uses sample-specific H3 visual conditioning and whether the rollout-only missing normalized-action pre-clamp hurts closed-loop control.

parent_baseline.heldout: 40 tasks x 2 deterministic episode-disjoint windows; pending

equivalent: H3 clean feature timestep 1 versus Wan clean feature timestep 0; both mean clean observation
seeded uniform timestep sampling versus unseeded uniform sampling; distribution is unchanged
intentional_deviation: H3/Qwen 5120-d text context replaces Wan/T5 4096-d context
frozen INT8 H3 layer49 cached tokens replace StarWAM's trainable Wan last-layer features
single final-layer feature context replaces DreamWAM's per-layer video K/V carrier
100-step 0.0032-epoch canary is far below upstream optimization budgets
mismatch: The offline evaluator follows StarWAM and clamps normalized action to [-1,1] before minmax denormalization, while the rollout helper denormalizes without pre-clamp and only clips after gripper conversion in physical action space.
not_applicable: MiniWorld actions are video-prediction conditions rather than predicted action targets
MiniWorld diffusion-forcing timestep curriculum is a video objective
MiniWorld block-causal temporal mask is a video streaming mask, not an ActionDiT action-token mask
unknown: magnitude of causal dependence on H3 visual features
closed-loop effect of the rollout normalized-action pre-clamp mismatch

selected_experiments.falsifiable_hypothesis: If R1 uses sample-specific H3 visual information, a deterministic cross-sample visual-feature permutation with identical action noise will change predictions and worsen held-out action metrics.
selected_experiments.single_variable: Permute only h3_features across the frozen selected sample IDs using salt h3-r1-visual-shuffle-v1.
selected_experiments.implementation: scripts/h3wam/evaluate_h3_int8_starwam_action.py --visual-feature-shuffle; requires --samples-per-task 2 and validates fixed 80-ID mapping plus same-noise paired reports.
selected_experiments.tests: 29 passed, 2 subtests passed across evaluator, feature-action model and trainer tests
selected_experiments.withheld_reason: Do not start evaluation while the upstream agent is preparing the frozen baseline.

selected_experiments.falsifiable_hypothesis: If missing normalized-action pre-clamp amplifies out-of-domain flow samples, adding only StarWAM's clamp(-1,1) before rollout minmax denormalization will reduce abnormal or saturated actions and improve a fixed LIBERO canary.
selected_experiments.single_variable: Enable normalized_actions.clamp(-1,1) immediately before rollout minmax denormalization.
selected_experiments.blocker: Deployment helper needs an explicit recorded pre-clamp option and round-trip/unit tests before launch.

decision.rationale: This is a no-GPU audit line. Complete the frozen held-out baseline, then run the paired visual-conditioning ablation and the rollout pre-clamp contract A/B before changing action-flow math or launching another training branch.
